reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but the new range handler independently implements occurrence exclusion policy.

duplication.why: The excluded-day decision is repeated across forward traversal, reverse traversal, and range enumeration.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared schedules, but the server range handler also owns scheduling policy that should be shared with existing consumers.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested scheduling features, their configuration plumbing, and associated tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate several independently implemented occurrence policies, while the new untyped handler and fixed three-day padding obscure the scheduling contract.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts:getDatesInRange directly enumerates recurrences and reconstructs daily exclusion policy instead of sharing the effective-occurrence decision with shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange reshapes getNextDate's daily exclusion decision into a flatMap filter, while getNextDate repeats the same exclusion predicate in forward and reverse loops.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate adds forward and reverse daily-exclusion loops and a daily exception to adjustment; getDatesInRange, getUpcomingDates, and both schedule-template adjustment sites independently apply occurrence policy outside getNextDate.
